question: A is the mother of G. G is the mother of D. D is the son of H. R is the father of H. How is A related to R?
solution:
From the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2845245e4110626e67a44d69ae9072e1fd5c78d0d480943856d7071cc4dba879.png]
